summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Evidence Quality Scoring Module and Start Route checklist changes. All 13 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend features verified working correctly. Fixed one bug: FastResponse import missing in quality-export endpoint.

issues: React warning: indicatorClassName prop not recognized on DOM element - minor console warning, doesn't affect functionality (pre-existing from iteration 4)

start_route_checklist_order.details: Checklist is in correct chronological order: 1) CEDIS arrival, 2) CEDIS pass, 3) Cosmo route, 4) Packages scanned, 5) Retry registered, 6) WhatsApp, 7) Odometer photo (opcional), 8) CEDIS screenshot (opcional), 9) Zone confirmed

optional_checklist_items.details: Items 7 (odometer_photo) and 8 (cedis_screenshot) show '(opcional)' label in grey text

start_route_photo_optional.details: Photo upload shows '(opcional)' label and help text: 'Solo si genera valor adicional — las evidencias en WhatsApp y Cosmo son el respaldo principal.'

dashboard_quality_kpi.details: Dashboard shows 5th KPI card 'CALIDAD DE SOPORTE' with percentage and 'Todos completos' subtext. Color coding works (green>=90, amber>=70, red<70)

journey_package_table_soporte_column.details: Package table has 'Soporte' column with Completo/Parcial/Incompleto badges

journey_package_table_evidencias_column.details: Package table has 'Evidencias' column with camera icon (proof count), note icon (driver note), warning icon (missing items)

journey_calidad_tab.details: Calidad tab (4th tab) shows: Score promedio (88%), Soporte completo (37/45), Sin soporte (4), Distribution bar (82% green, 9% amber, 9% red), 'Solo incompletos' filter, 'Re-evaluar' button, Detalle por paquete table

evaluate_journey_endpoint.details: POST /api/reports/evaluate-journey/{id} returns evaluated count, avg_score, complete, partial, incomplete

quality_report_endpoint.details: GET /api/reports/quality returns by_provider, by_type, worst_packages, summary data

quality_export_endpoint.details: POST /api/reports/quality-export returns Excel file with packages having score < 100

reports_quality_section.details: Reports page has 'Calidad de soporte' section with 'Cargar datos' and 'Exportar para Cubbo' buttons. Shows summary cards after loading.

whatsapp_close_summary_quality.details: generateWhatsAppCloseSummary includes quality block with: Soporte completo/parcial/sin soporte counts, Score promedio, Paquetes que requieren atención

bug_fixed.root_cause: FastResponse was not imported in the export_quality_report function
bug_fixed.fix: Added 'from fastapi.responses import Response as FastResponse' import inside the function

test_credentials.developer: dev@me.mx / LastMile2026 (full access except Reports page)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing journey with scored data (778b38e3-4e68-4b85-ad74-24ae02fef468) containing 45 scored packages with avg 88% score.

Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_evidence_quality.py cover: POST /api/reports/evaluate-journey/{id}, GET /api/reports/quality, POST /api/reports/quality-export, dashboard stats with quality KPI, journey packages with evidence fields.
